successors.name: Joseon
successors.text: Jeju Island, which Taejong of Joseon 'placed under firm central control' in 1404

ledger.x: 263: Tamna enters the map as the Jeju Island kingdom.
1404: Taejong of Joseon ends the Tamna kingdom.

wars.name: Sambyeolcho Rebellion
wars.outcome: The rebellion 'came to a bloody end on Jeju Island in 1274'; the island then ran as Tamna Prefecture under the Yuan, 1275 to 1301.

certainty.note: The island's coast is a natural limit, but Tamna's political status moved between independence, tribute and local autonomy (infobox: independent ?-498 and 925-938, tributary or vassal at other times) and the pages give no territorial…
